# Component reference

Augma 0.2.2: 13 Vue 3.5+ components. Each is a named export of `augma`; load the stylesheet once in the app entry.

```ts
import { AgmButton } from 'augma'
import 'augma/style.css'
```

- [AgmButton](#agmbutton): A light touch, an instant response. Triggers actions and state changes.
- [AgmIconButton](#agmiconbutton): A round action button that gives its icon a clear accessible name.
- [AgmInput](#agminput): Clear labels and error messages keep every entry on track.
- [AgmSelect](#agmselect): Choose from a clear list of options.
- [AgmSwitch](#agmswitch): Instantly toggles a clear on/off state.
- [AgmSlider](#agmslider): Adjusts a value with continuous feedback, by touch or keyboard.
- [AgmDialog](#agmdialog): Keeps attention on the task at hand, then returns you to where you were.
- [AgmTooltip](#agmtooltip): Adds a short explanation to a focusable control.
- [AgmToast](#agmtoast): Light, dismissible feedback for results and reminders.
- [AgmPanel](#agmpanel): A light, translucent container that gives related information structure.
- [AgmHudStatus](#agmhudstatus): Shows status changes with both text and color.
- [AgmHudProgress](#agmhudprogress): Linear or ring progress that keeps a process visible.
- [AgmHudGauge](#agmhudgauge): Shows remaining capacity in segments, with a brief afterimage when the value drops.

## AgmButton

Button: A light touch, an instant response. Triggers actions and state changes.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | 'primary' \| 'outline' \| 'ghost' | 'primary' | Visual emphasis |
| `disabled` | boolean | false | Blocks interaction |
| `loading` | boolean | false | Shows work in progress and blocks repeated actions |
| `type` | 'button' \| 'submit' \| 'reset' | 'button' | Native button type |

Slots:

- default: button text

Usage notes: Tab to focus; Enter or Space to activate. Loading and disabled buttons ignore input.

Editable source: `pnpm dlx shadcn-vue@2.8.2 add https://augma.yyj.moe/r/button.json`

Docs: https://augma.yyj.moe/en/components/button

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AgmButton, AgmHudStatus } from 'augma'
import { shallowRef } from 'vue'

const count = shallowRef(0)
</script>

<template>
  <div class="example-demo">
    <div class="example-row">
      <AgmButton @click="count++">Connect device</AgmButton>
      <AgmButton variant="outline" @click="count++">Secondary action</AgmButton>
      <AgmButton variant="ghost" @click="count++">Subtle action</AgmButton>
      <AgmButton loading>Loading</AgmButton>
      <AgmButton disabled>Unavailable</AgmButton>
    </div>
    <AgmHudStatus :tone="count ? 'success' : 'neutral'">
      Clicks: <strong class="example-count">{{ count }}</strong>
    </AgmHudStatus>
  </div>
</template>

<style scoped>
.example-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
}
.example-stack {
  display: grid;
  gap: 24px;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 360px;
}
/* The readout sits on its own line, so the button row never moves as the count grows. */
.example-demo {
  display: grid;
  justify-items: start;
  gap: 20px;
}
.example-count {
  color: var(--agm-text);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
</style>
```

## AgmInput

## AgmSelect

Select: Choose from a clear list of options.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | undefined | Optional ID for the trigger element; generated by default |
| `hint` | string | undefined | Helper text linked to the select and kept while an error shows |
| `error` | string | undefined | Error message; also marks the field invalid |
| `required` | boolean | false | Required form field |
| `modelValue` | string | undefined | Updated through v-model |
| `label` | string | Required | Visible label |
| `options` | { label: string, value: string, disabled?: boolean }[] | Required | Each value must be a unique, non-empty string |
| `placeholder` | string | '请选择' | Text shown before a choice is made |
| `disabled` | boolean | false | Blocks selection |
| `name` | string | undefined | Form field name |

Events: `update:modelValue(string)`

Usage notes: Enter / Space opens, arrow keys move, Enter selects and Escape closes; type-ahead search skips disabled options. class / style stay on the field wrapper, other attributes and listeners go to the trigger button; hint / error are linked automatically.

Editable source: `pnpm dlx shadcn-vue@2.8.2 add https://augma.yyj.moe/r/select.json`

Docs: https://augma.yyj.moe/en/components/select

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AgmButton, AgmSelect } from 'augma'
import { shallowRef } from 'vue'

const mode = shallowRef('focus')
const destination = shallowRef<string>()
const submitted = shallowRef(false)
const options = [
  { label: 'Focus mode', value: 'focus' },
  { label: 'Explore mode', value: 'explore' },
  { label: 'Unavailable mode', value: 'locked', disabled: true },
]
</script>

<template>
  <div class="example-stack">
    <AgmSelect v-model="mode" label="Display mode" hint="Choose how much information the current scene shows." :options="options" />
    <output>Selected: {{ mode }}</output>
    <AgmSelect
      v-model="destination"
      label="Launch mode"
      hint="Choose an available mode before launching."
      placeholder="Select a mode"
      :error="submitted && !destination ? 'Choose a launch mode' : undefined"
      :options="options"
      required
    />
    <AgmButton variant="outline" @click="submitted = true">Confirm launch mode</AgmButton>
    <output v-if="submitted && destination" role="status">Launch mode confirmed.</output>
    <AgmSelect label="Unavailable select" placeholder="Select a mode" :options="options" disabled />
  </div>
</template>

<style scoped>
.example-stack {
  display: grid;
  gap: 24px;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 360px;
}
</style>
```

## AgmDialog

Dialog: Keeps attention on the task at hand, then returns you to where you were.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | boolean | false | Updated through v-model:open |
| `title` | string | Required | Accessible title |
| `description` | string | Required | Explains the task |
| `closeLabel` | string | '关闭对话框' | Accessible name of the close button |

Events: `update:open(boolean)`

Slots:

- trigger: a single focusable trigger element
- default: content
- footer: action area

Usage notes: Opening moves focus into the dialog, Tab cycles within it, and Escape closes it and returns focus to the trigger. Use the trigger slot so focus can return.

Editable source: `pnpm dlx shadcn-vue@2.8.2 add https://augma.yyj.moe/r/dialog.json`

## AgmToast

Toast: Light, dismissible feedback for results and reminders.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger' \| 'neutral' | 'success' | Status meaning; the title must state the result too, not rely on color alone |
| `open` | boolean | false | Updated through v-model:open |
| `title` | string | Required | Notification title |
| `description` | string | undefined | Supporting text |
| `duration` | number | 5000 | Time before it closes automatically (ms) |
| `closeLabel` | string | '关闭通知' | Accessible name of the close button |
| `regionLabel` | string | '通知（F8）' | Accessible name of the notification region; mention the F8 shortcut |

Events: `update:open(boolean)`

Usage notes: F8 focuses the notification region; Escape or the close button dismisses it. The countdown pauses on hover or focus. Use one AgmToast per app.

Editable source: `pnpm dlx shadcn-vue@2.8.2 add https://augma.yyj.moe/r/toast.json`

Docs: https://augma.yyj.moe/en/components/toast

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AgmButton, AgmToast } from 'augma'
import { computed, nextTick, shallowRef } from 'vue'

const messages = {
  success: { title: 'Settings saved', description: 'Your new display preferences are in effect.' },
  warning: { title: 'Low battery', description: 'Connect to power to keep going.' },
  danger: { title: 'Sync incomplete', description: 'Check your network connection and try again.' },
  neutral: { title: 'Preview mode', description: 'Actions here only affect this local example.' },
}
const open = shallowRef(false)
const tone = shallowRef<keyof typeof messages>('success')
const message = computed(() => messages[tone.value])

async function show(nextTone: keyof typeof messages) {
  open.value = false
  await nextTick()
  tone.value = nextTone
  open.value = true
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="example-row">
    <AgmButton @click="show('success')">Save settings</AgmButton>
    <AgmButton variant="outline" @click="show('warning')">Show warning</AgmButton>
    <AgmButton variant="outline" @click="show('danger')">Simulate failure</AgmButton>
    <AgmButton variant="ghost" @click="show('neutral')">Show message</AgmButton>
    <AgmToast
      v-model:open="open"
      :tone="tone"
      :title="message.title"
      :description="message.description"
      close-label="Close notification"
      region-label="Notifications (F8)"
    />
  </div>
</template>

<style scoped>
.example-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
}
</style>
```

## AgmPanel

Panel: A light, translucent container that gives related information structure.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `description` | string | undefined | Supporting text under the title; a custom header slot replaces it |
| `title` | string | undefined | Panel title |

Slots:

- default: content
- header: custom title and description
- actions: header actions, also available without a title
- footer: bottom action area

Usage notes: The panel does not take focus itself; its content follows the natural document order.

Editable source: `pnpm dlx shadcn-vue@2.8.2 add https://augma.yyj.moe/r/panel.json`

Docs: https://augma.yyj.moe/en/components/panel

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AgmButton, AgmHudProgress, AgmHudStatus, AgmPanel } from 'augma'
import { shallowRef } from 'vue'

const progress = shallowRef(72)
</script>

<template>
  <AgmPanel title="Device overview" description="Check the sync status and update the progress." style="width: 100%; max-width: 400px">
    <template #actions>
      <AgmHudStatus :tone="progress === 100 ? 'success' : 'neutral'">{{ progress === 100 ? 'Synced' : 'Not synced' }}</AgmHudStatus>
    </template>
    <AgmHudProgress label="Sample progress" :value="progress" />
    <template #footer>
      <AgmButton variant="ghost" :disabled="progress === 72" @click="progress = 72">Reset</AgmButton>
      <AgmButton :disabled="progress === 100" @click="progress = 100">Finish sync</AgmButton>
    </template>
  </AgmPanel>
</template>
```

## AgmHudProgress

HudProgress: Linear or ring progress that keeps a process visible.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string | Required | Progress name |
| `value` | number | undefined | Leave it out, or pass a non-finite number, for indeterminate progress |
| `max` | number | 100 | Upper bound; invalid values fall back to 100 |
| `variant` | 'bar' \| 'ring' | 'bar' | Display style |
| `indeterminateText` | string | '进行中' | Text a bar shows while progress is indeterminate |

Usage notes: Read-only progress uses progressbar semantics; the value is clamped to 0–max, and indeterminate progress leaves out aria-valuenow.

Editable source: `pnpm dlx shadcn-vue@2.8.2 add https://augma.yyj.moe/r/hud-progress.json`

Docs: https://augma.yyj.moe/en/components/hud-progress

## AgmHudGauge

HudGauge: Shows remaining capacity in segments, with a brief afterimage when the value drops.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string | Required | Gauge name |
| `value` | number | Required | Current value, clamped to 0–max; non-finite numbers count as 0 |
| `max` | number | 100 | Upper bound; invalid values fall back to 100 |

Usage notes: Read-only gauges use meter semantics, with "current / max" as the value text. At 50% or less it shows the warning color, at 20% or less the danger color; the number stays visible so color is never the only cue.

Editable source: `pnpm dlx shadcn-vue@2.8.2 add https://augma.yyj.moe/r/hud-gauge.json`

Docs: https://augma.yyj.moe/en/components/hud-gauge

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AgmButton, AgmHudGauge } from 'augma'
import { shallowRef } from 'vue'

const battery = shallowRef(86)
</script>

<template>
  <div class="example-stack">
    <AgmHudGauge label="Device battery" :value="battery" />
    <AgmHudGauge label="Free storage" :value="12" :max="64" />
    <div class="example-row">
      <AgmButton variant="outline" :disabled="battery === 0" @click="battery = Math.max(0, battery - 18)">
        Simulate drain
      </AgmButton>
      <AgmButton variant="ghost" :disabled="battery === 100" @click="battery = 100">
        Charge fully
      </AgmButton>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<style scoped>
```
